# Third-party code

## World4YouApi.py

Vendored from [NerLOR/World4YouApi](https://github.com/NerLOR/World4YouApi) (read-only DNS listing for health checks).

Update with:

```bash
curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NerLOR/World4YouApi/master/src/World4YouApi.py \
  -o scripts/third_party/World4YouApi.py
```
